fast_trail._note: Once a position earns this (via 'trigger'), its stop can ratchet up to this faster SMA - but only ever tightens, never loosens below the normal SMA20. Disabled by default: with enabled=false this whole block is a no-op and backtests are unaffected. 'trigger' selects which condition below gates it: 'min_holding_weeks' (a trade that's run long enough has proven the trend, start protecting it faster) or 'min_unrealized_gain_pct' (protect gains once there are real gains to protect) - only the matching threshold field is read.
